items.reason: A gentle, active-free cleanser keeps skin clean without stripping it.
Hyaluronic serum adds light hydration, which suits your moisture score and can make skin look smoother.
A lightweight mattifying gel moisturizer suits oily-feeling skin and helps skin look more even.
Mineral SPF 50 protects skin each morning and is a gentle choice for daily wear.

response.routine_note: I've left out the 15% lactic acid serum because a high-strength acid is best checked with your prenatal care provider first, so this routine sticks to gentle basics for smoother-looking skin. Use the cleanser, hydrating serum and gel moisturizer morning and evening, and finish with the mineral SPF each morning.
